page.overview:
Who is Jurassic Park Maintenance Worker 3?

This maintenance employee was one of the last introduced characters of Jurassic Park. He was described as Costa Rican.

He was seen by John Hammond walking towards the lodge, and then became alarmed when he saw several compies in the area. He escaped the island with everyone else and was the last person to see Hammond alive.
